comment: Frame generation title binding: Cyberpunk 2077 on game-interface build 2.14.1 (exe file version 3.0). Behaviour, layouts and call shapes from the read-only inspection of the installed game and its logs; values only, no text. The interface's export names (roles) and the shared structure GUIDs (viewport, tag, resource, constants, requirements) are the RR binding's for 2.14 (interface_binding), and the interface file name is the RR binding's (interface_file): one source for both features. The game imports the interface by name in its static import table, so the transport is the import-table redirect from WrongGPU-FG.asi; the DXGI factory the game creates through the interface's own factory export (factory_import) is where the swap-chain hook goes. Read at configure time by ../CMakeLists.txt (generated header in the build tree; never edited by hand).
